warnings: [NETWORK] System is using a short hostname instead of an FQDN. Active Directory heavily relies on fully qualified domain names.
[TUNING] If AD users authenticate but fail authorization (missing groups), consider setting 'ldap_use_tokengroups = False'.
[TUNING] No LDAP timeout specified. Adding 'timeout = 30' can help stabilize slow Active Directory connections.
[DIAGNOSTIC HINT] SSSD debug level is low. To get better logs, set debug_level=9 in sssd.conf, restart sssd, reproduce the error, and generate a new supportconfig.
